svg.title: Golden sun achievement badge
svg.desc: The golden frame grows from the center. A glossy golden sun blooms, eight curved flame rays unfurl in sequence, and smaller golden rays pop into place. The sun rays gently change size and rotate while confetti, starbursts, and dancing golden beams keep celebrating. Transparent vector artwork, with matching WAV audio supplied separately.

g.aria-label: Gold rays, colorful confetti, and sparkling stars
